name: a defect the change introduced still blocks
prompt: Review this change. The diff wraps the repository call in `OrdersController.Cancel` (src/OrdersController.cs:60-75) in a try/catch whose catch block is empty, then returns Ok(). Before the change the exception propagated to the global exception filter and the client received a 500 with ProblemDetails. Build and tests pass; there is no test for the failure path. Write the verdict and the findings.
why: The warn rule must not soften review of what the change itself did: a swallowed exception the diff added is a real defect with a concrete scenario.
